thread:
Raj Patel: kicking off canary rollout v2.14 to beta (3% traffic). perf targets p50<60ms p95<200ms. please monitor p99 and any memory regressions. rolling at 13:04 UTC.
Sasha Kim: saw p99 jump to ~920ms on one host, looks like tokenization stall. pushing logs: `ERROR Tokenizer::cache_miss token=0x3f4a` link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/perf/rl-8291
Mike O'Neill: on it, instrumenting tok_path, grabbing perf traces now. running lightweight repro to isolate.
Infra-bot: Deployment v2.14 started on cluster beta-3 by Raj Patel - rollout id rl-8291.
Jess Carter: also seeing increased lua GC on gpu-worker-7, low-level logs attached to the incident thread.
Sasha Kim: here's quick stack snippet from the trace: ```
#0 0x7f8a1b2c tokenize_impl
#1 0x7f8a2d3e model_forward
#2 0x7f8a3f50 runtime_step
```
Might be a memcopy hotspot when token cache misses align with long sequences.
Mike O'Neill: repro command I'm running: `ab -n 500 -c 10 https://beta.api.redwood/v1/generate` — will post results in 2m.
Carol Li: pinging eng-runtime — could this be the combo of the tokenizer change + new quantization path? Seen similar in staging before.
Raj Patel: we need a quick decision: continue canary or stop? current aggregate p99 is 80ms but 3 hosts show 800-1k ms. leaning to hold & rollback to v2.13 for safety. thoughts?
Jess Carter: +1 hold. Don't want to risk customer-facing regressions.
Sasha Kim: Agree. I'll open a hotfix branch to revert the tokenizer patch and start bisecting.
Mike O'Neill: I'll prepare rollback plan and can force traffic back to v2.13 in ~5m if no objections. Need infra permission for immediate rollback.
Raj Patel: no objections from me. @Infra-bot start rollback rl-8291 -> v2.13
Infra-bot: Rollback initiated: rl-8291 -> v2.13. Estimated completion 120s. Notifying oncall.
Carol Li: after rollback completes, let's collect perf traces from the three problematic hosts and schedule a profiling deep-dive tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Also tag metrics windows so we can compare.
Raj Patel: follow-ups: create incident ticket with logs + assign to Sasha (tokenizer) and Mike (deploy/infra). Postmortem checkpoint: root cause triage + regression test to catch this in preflight. Thanks all :thumbsup:
